This suggests that a fixed-term tenancy of 12 months may not be permitted, as it does not meet the criteria for a valid rent period.

According to Section 2 of the Renters' Rights Act 2025, assured shorthold tenancies are abolished. 

Section 2 states: "In the 1988 Act—
(a) omit section 6A (demotion to assured shorthold tenancy because of anti-social behaviour);
(b) omit Chapter 2 of Part 1 (assured shorthold tenancies)."

This means that assured shorthold tenancies are no longer a type of tenancy that can be created.
